title: Why is my retention trash? Orbit Shift, lane-switching score attack radial infinite runner.
author: caesium23
selftext:
[Orbit Shift](https://playgama.com/game/orbit-shift?clid=p_378af4bf-f2b1-4559-8d65-6e8fa32c90c6) was my first attempt at AI game dev. It was inspired by a popular mobile game I used to play called Ninjump. In Ninjump, you ran infinitely up a pair of walls, occasionally tapping to jump between them to either avoid an obstacle or catch a power-up. Back in the day, I probably put hundreds of hours into that game. It was a lot of fun, even if the game play was very simple and it literally only had one input. 

I tried to capture that simple but addictive game play in Orbit Shift, but with a radial track and a space theme to make it unique and not just a knockoff. I posted it to Playgama, where it gets a steady trickle of traffic. But the retention is *zero*. People find the game, play for maybe 5 minutes, and then they never come back.

Clearly, I didn't capture the fun. What is my game missing? What do I need to add or change so that players will want to come back?

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/caesium23 could you please add details on how AI was used to make this? Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion with nothing to discuss otherwise. If you don't update, this post may be removed.
